# API Security and Reliability Checklist: Admin Approves or Rejects Companies

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for admin-only access, double decisions and email failures are complete and unambiguous before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Access Control

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the allowed roles stated for every admin action (list, view one, approve, reject)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the response to a signed-in non-admin distinguished from the response to an anonymous visitor? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases E3]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is it stated which recruiter-facing data (own status, reason) is visible only to that company's owner, and not on the public company page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it specified whether the owner's contact email may appear in admin responses only, and never in public ones? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]

## Double Decisions

- [ ] CHK005 - Is "only a pending company may be decided" defined for all three transitions (pending to approved, pending to rejected, and any attempt from approved or rejected)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 - Does the spec say what the second admin is told (the current status) and that nothing else changes, including the reason and the reviewer? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases E1]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is SC-003 ("exactly one decision applied") measurable with a concrete concurrent scenario? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the race between a recruiter registering a new company and an admin deciding on their old one addressed? [Coverage, Gap]

## Rejection Reason

- [ ] CHK009 - Are the reason limits (blank, spaces only, over 1000 characters) stated in one place and consistent between the Story, FR-004 and Clarifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is it stated that approving clears an earlier reason, and is that consistent with "a rejected company is never edited"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-012]

## Email Failure Handling

- [ ] CHK011 - Is it explicit that the decision is saved before the email is attempted, so a mail outage cannot undo it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is it specified whether a failed email is retried, or only logged? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the content of each email defined (company name, outcome, reason when rejected), and is it stated that no other private data is included? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is SC-004 ("exactly one email per decision") consistent with a refused second decision sending no email? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004, §FR-005]

## Re-registration

- [ ] CHK015 - Is "the recruiter's own company is the most recently registered one" defined well enough to settle which company they see after several rejections? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the effect of re-registration on job posting stated (a rejected company never posts; only the new one after approval)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
